title: 原Run修改后固定检查
scope: V1-09 production composition; explicit check source policy and immutable capture-time proof; full five-group S1 goal remains active
implementation: Trusted explicit original_run_edits/1.0.0 templates; Context baseline pins; fixed entry and fixed inputs unchanged
Original Native same-Run write-chain resolver; conservative Windows case fold; unresolved/foreign/branch/cycle/duplicate/fixed-harness changes rejected
Actual native broker capture under receipt-derived expected digests; source history checked before dispatch; copied read-only snapshot and bounded check execution
Private catalog/request/sources/receipt/SDK output 2; complete source_basis_digest propagated through original IPC and SDK correlation; strict legacy 1 semantics preserved
Historical replay returns original receipt without re-execution; independent reader validates captured original Native write subset and complete source proof

must_fix: Windows case-sensitive source match could hide alias cycles or fixed harness writes
Later legitimate Native receipt could replace capture-time source proof because references were not bound by completion digest

evidence_boundaries: Actual Native checks validate source 2 as passed and source 3 as failed; old original-source policy rejects modified bytes
Actual Windows Native src/QUERY.ts edit is included in lower-case catalog source; actual future legitimate edit receipt substitution is refused
Actual SDK path reached original read/edit and check request but did not complete; no Kernel observation from those incomplete SDK fixtures

First model port incorrectly reused first-launch qualification after legitimate edits; changing only constructed fixture to current Run tool-authority checks preserves Kernel startup refusal; original precise denial reasons were not captured, interpretation follows code and post-edit launch assertion
One final SDK failure: original native_control_unavailable caused parent ending and workspace_effect_cancelled; precise failed control helper/OS cause not proven
Isolated SDK recheck: granted phase ArgumentNullException and no suspended runtime, not counted as the same failure cause
All constructed model/account/Skill qualification remains non-production; production collection actual credential/model request counters remain null, not inferred zero
No paid model request or real credential read was performed in this batch; no historical Unknown resource cleanup, same-Run restart, reset, clean or force push
Logical history bounds are not physical quota or complete billing proof
remaining: Production Native preparation/control stability and exact helper failure cause
Formal positive domain output/Contract/Task verification and exact SDK final output
Approved real Zhipu model/plan/cash/points and external credential/account custody, service-side bounds and billing
Real Skill and pre-Plan Human/Matt clarification for all entrances
Independent complete Matt/current-source Superpowers and real behavior comparison
Default formal Workbench Agent execution and original continuation
Real ordinary Change to ReadyForDelivery and full S1/operator acceptance guide
